text: およいでる　ひとが　みえる！

structure.jp: およいでる　ひとが

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: The verb before ひと tells you which people are meant. およいでる　ひと = 'people who are swimming'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something is going on now; でる is the shortened spoken form of でいる. およいでる = 'are swimming'.
